exposure: AIH relapse in the year before conception
cohort: The study included 97 pregnancies in 50 women with autoimmune hepatitis (AIH) from 11 hospitals in the Netherlands.
finding: Incomplete biochemical response at conception or relapse in the year before conception are risk factors for gestational and post-partum relapses, hypertensive disorders, and intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP), while cirrhosis was a risk factor for miscarriages.
